note: RULING 55 (2026-08-21) — a photo never blocks anything, and every photo is reviewed by Sean. Only an APPROVED photo renders; a PENDING one renders initials, which this product treats as a success. Nothing else on the card is affected by any of this: name, party, blurb, contacts, filed address, funding and votes render exactly as they would if no photo had ever been found. This is a CORRECTNESS gate on one field, never a completeness gate on a card — see lib/photos/review.ts for why the distinction is the rule. A REJECTED photo is a branch result under RULING 52: this image is not this person, and nothing about whether a correct portrait exists.

VICTOR ORLANDO.reason: Read as an image 2026-08-21: a stock photograph of the United States flag against a blue sky. There is no person in it. The filename, the path (/images/headshots/) and the alt text ('Victor Orlando') all say formal headshot. A hunt that trusted any of the three would have shipped a flag as this man's face.
